title: PPIA-14 Safe Action and Affordance Classes

affordance_classes.rule: Close or return without changing authoritative state.
Edit only fields already visible/editable to the subject.
Repeat a nonmutating read when the upstream failure is retryable.
Attempt to restore transport; does not imply mutation success.
Use an authorized operation/status reference to resolve status-unknown.
Retry only when upstream operation_id/idempotency/status semantics prove it safe.
Refresh a derived projection after an accepted durable Event.
Inspect the current authorized version before deciding next action.
Open an upstream-defined conflict review; microcopy does not resolve it.
Open context-authorized help without expanding visibility.
Create/report only with F025 minimum fields, consent/redaction and operation rules.

forbidden_affordances: blind retry of an ambiguous mutation result
action whose presence proves a hidden resource exists
permission escalation or local authorization override
forced conflict overwrite not defined by upstream authority
action invented for unresolved F024 Pack lifecycle behavior
AI action that decides permission, recovery, approval or canonical truth
mutation_rule: A mutation-labelled affordance is only a presentation of an upstream-authorized operation. PPIA-14 never creates mutation authority.
